details:
I am introducing a system that could:

- Help users find new friends with common interests better

- Help users find new worlds and groups that are focused on their interests better

- Help users find active instances with their interests better and faster

- Help with old worlds with discoverability

This system will introduce new "Interest Tags".

These tags are oriented about common actions people do in VRChat. Such as "World Exploratiom" "Karaoke" "Just Chilling" "RP" and "Avatar Creation" (full list on the attached image-graphic)

You could choose those tags for yourself (in your profile), for your worlds, for your groups and for your instances.

Practical uses of this system:

- Add interest tags to your own profile, so people can see your interests + these can be used further (see more below)

- Add interest tags to worlds

- Add interest tags groups

- Add interest tags to instances

- Add search worlds by interest tags

- Add search groups by interest tags

- Add search instances by interest tags

For more details and explanation please check the attached image-graphic. It explains most of this proposed system. 

The Tag listed in the image-graphic are not a final list. More can be added.

The following examples will make sense after you read the attached image-graphic.

Example #1:

An User sees another user. They open their bio and find out they have a common interest. Now they have a topic to talk about.

Example #2:

An user wants to find a new group focused around Clubbing. 

They go to the Groups tab and clicks "Search by interests" and chooses Clubbing. They can find more clubbing oriented groups easily.

Example #3:

An user wants to find some active game Karaoke worlds. They go to the "By Interests" tab and click the Karaoke worlds tab to find them more easily.

Example #4:

An user creates a public lobby of a world called "Super Murder 5". They tag the instance as a game world.

People who want to join game worlds can find this world more easily in the worlds - by interests + with "active instances" selected.

(This system kind of resembles a "LFG" system in an MMORPG)

This might be especially good for people who want to play older game worlds with people, that are not easily discoverable.

This system seems to be partially introduced already with the "avatar worlds" and "game worlds" tabs ingame.
title: Interest Tags system for user profiles, worlds, groups and instances
